what: Independent blind relabel of blind-inputs.jsonl by a second AI reader (Claude Fable, a separate session that saw only blind-inputs.jsonl and questions.json), compared with reference-labels.jsonl after the fact. The reference labels were not changed.
limits: Both readers are LLMs; agreement between two AI readers is not human validation and does not open the author axis in the sense of decision:a-gate-whose-rule-and-exam-share-an-author-ships-off.

Every synthetic family holds exactly one supports, one contradicts and one same_as pair, so the fixture design is contrastive and the labels are easy to recover from the text; full agreement is weak evidence of label quality.
The 120 frozen candidate pairs are all negative on every predicate, so the review exercised positives only on synthetic fixtures.
